description: This Java source file defines the AccountController class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing bank accounts, including creation, retrieval, updating, deletion, balance inquiries, deposits, withdrawals, transfers, and transaction history. It uses Spring Boot annotations to define routes and Swagger annotations for documentation.

classes.name: AccountController
classes.description: REST controller exposing endpoints for account management and transactions in a banking application.

methods.name: createAccount
methods.description: Creates a new bank account, optionally linked to a customer ID.

methods.name: getAccounts
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all bank accounts.

methods.name: getAccount
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific account by ID.

methods.name: updateAccount
methods.description: Updates metadata of a specific account, excluding balance.

methods.name: getBalance
methods.description: Retrieves the current balance of a specific account.

methods.name: deposit
methods.description: Deposits an amount into an account.

methods.name: withdraw
methods.description: Withdraws an amount from an account.

methods.name: transfer
methods.description: Transfers funds from one account to another.

methods.name: getTransactions
methods.description: Retrieves transaction history for an account.
